results.releaseNotes:
NEW FEATURES
- Emby joins Plex and Jellyfin as a first-class backend for onboarding, browsing, search, watch state, and downloads
- Tracker sign-in dialogs now show a QR code and copyable link
- MDBList adds watched-history sync, ratings, and scrobbling
- Library context menus gain a watchlist toggle
- Appearance gains an option to hide the Explore tab
- Text subtitles can sit at the bottom of the screen, including beneath widescreen video
- Playback Buffer now offers Auto, Large, and Extra Large tiers

PLAYBACK
- Plex transcodes now open at the resume position
- Transcoded subtitles are delivered correctly again across Plex and Jellyfin
- Repeated stream-open failures now show an actionable dialog
- Playback skips count from the position where the jump actually landed
- Keyboard Enter no longer switches the app into focus navigation
- Escape exits only fullscreen sessions entered by the player
- Watch Together accepts clock replies only from the host and stays anchored while the host reloads
- Marking an item watched now clears its resume position and queued progress
- Refreshed Discover rows correctly replace stale local watch-state patches

MUSIC
- Shuffle now includes the head of the queue
- Gapless track changes report the correct timeline, preventing phantom Plex plays and Last.fm scrobbles

LIVE TV
- Guide rows follow their displayed order across multiple DVRs
- An empty favorites-filtered guide explains the state and offers Show All Channels

UI
- Sheets size to their content instead of filling most of the screen
- Delete-from-server dialogs identify exactly what will be removed
- The profile picker keeps its highlight while sorting
- Navigation labels are shorter on phones, and all 21 translations are complete
results.description:
Plezy is a modern client for Plex, Jellyfin, and Emby, built for high-quality playback, effortless discovery, and offline access. Connect multiple servers at once and enjoy your media in one clean, native app—no subscription required.

BROWSE & DISCOVER
- Browse libraries, collections, playlists, folders, extras, and personalized recommendations
- Search across every connected Plex, Jellyfin, and Emby server
- Explore trending, popular, watchlist, and recommendation rows from Plex Discover, Trakt, MyAnimeList, AniList, Simkl, and Seerr
- Match catalog titles back to your own libraries and request movies or shows through Seerr
- See resolution, HDR, Dolby Vision, and audio-format badges at a glance

PLAYBACK
- Wide codec support including HEVC, AV1, VP9, and more
- HDR playback, direct play, and configurable transcode quality
- Switch between media versions with detailed file and stream information
- Full ASS/SSA subtitles with styling controls and online subtitle search
- Auto-play the next episode with skip intro and skip credits
- Chapter navigation, thumbnail scrubbing, playback speed, audio sync, sleep timer, and video zoom
- Picture-in-Picture, loudness normalization, and stereo downmix with center-channel boost
- Resume progress and remembered audio/subtitle choices

MUSIC
- Browse artists, albums, and tracks with rich artwork
- Gapless playback with a reorderable queue, Play Next, and Add to Queue
- Synced lyrics, a persistent mini-player, and sleep timer
- Background playback with lock-screen and media controls
- Offline albums and tracks, plus selectable streaming quality

LIVE TV & DVR
- Browse and tune live channels with favorites and a full program guide
- See what's on, browse show schedules, and manage DVR recording rules
- Use Live TV across multiple supported servers

DOWNLOADS & OFFLINE
- Download movies, shows, albums, and tracks
- Pause or resume the background queue
- Create automatic download rules, including optional show specials
- Browse offline and sync watch state when you reconnect

PROFILES & INTEGRATIONS
- Use multiple profiles with per-profile settings, downloads, and watch state
- Switch Plex Home users with optional PIN protection
- Discover Jellyfin and Emby servers locally and use Quick Connect
- Sync watchlists, ratings, watched state, and scrobbles with connected services
- Watch together with synchronized play, pause, and seeking
- Control desktop and TV devices with Plezy Remote
- Available in English plus 21 translations

Some features require a supported server, media format, or connected service.

results.releaseNotes:
## New features

- All ratings the server sent are shown: IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes and TMDB side by side
- Local profiles borrow the picture of the connection they were linked to first
- File Info now works on music tracks and other file-backed items
- A two-finger tap toggles playback without raising the chrome

## Playback

- A picked subtitle language carries across episodes again, including untagged tracks
- Subtitles turned off, hidden or cycled stay off in the next episode
- Jellyfin's subtitle mode of None is no longer overridden by default or forced tracks
- A server that cannot read the media file now says so, instead of a redacted URL
- Live TV keeps retrying when a stream 404s
- Jellyfin streams the negotiated version on items with alternate versions
- Backspace and Home edit text again in player sheets, such as subtitle search
- Both player spinners are labelled for screen readers
- Pinching back to 100% zoom now snaps exactly
- The two-finger double tap no longer resets zoom; that stays in the settings sheet
- Plex no longer records a second play for one watch
- mpv no longer loads its yt-dlp hook, so failed opens are faster
- A track's lyric stream is no longer listed under "Embedded Images"

## Search, Explore & libraries

- Hidden libraries no longer appear in global search, on Plex or Jellyfin
- Explore lists every library copy of a title, each labelled with its resolution
- Explore's popular shelves show worldwide titles again, not just the app language
- "Delete from server" on Jellyfin follows the server's own permission, not the admin bit
- Instant Mix uses a wand icon instead of faders that read as an equalizer

## Performance

- The Discover tab loads once per cold start, not twice: 5.2s to 2.5s on Jellyfin
- Show detail paints before its on-deck episode is looked up: 18% faster on Jellyfin
- Opening a detail screen no longer issues duplicate requests

## Startup & storage

- A failed launch names the phase, error and stack, with copy and upload actions
- A damaged store can be repaired in place, and the screen leads with the repair
- A store whose bytes are not valid UTF-8 is now repairable too
- After a repair needing a restart, Retry is withdrawn rather than reopening a stale store
- A preference whose stored type no longer matches now uses the default instead of failing the boot
- Startup failures reach the crash reporter and Settings > Logs
results.description:
A powerful Plex and Jellyfin client focused on playback quality and offline access. Stream, download, and watch together — all with wide format support and no subscription required.

Playback

- Wide codec support including HEVC, AV1, VP9, and more
- HDR playback for stunning visual quality
- Advanced subtitle rendering with full ASS/SSA styling support
- Auto-skip intros and credits so you spend less time waiting
- Sleep timer for late-night viewing
- Variable playback speed control
- Auto-play next episode for uninterrupted binge sessions
- Resume exactly where you left off across devices

Downloads & Offline

- Download movies, shows, or entire seasons for offline viewing
- Play your downloads without an internet connection
- Watch progress syncs automatically when you're back online

Watch Together

- Create or join synchronized viewing sessions with friends
- Watch the same content in perfect sync, no matter where you are

Browsing & Discovery

- Browse your libraries with rich metadata and artwork
- Explore collections, playlists, and personalized recommendations
- Continue Watching keeps your in-progress content front and center
- Search across all your servers and media in one place
- Navigate easily through seasons, episodes, and extras

Profiles & Servers

- Multiple user profiles with optional PIN protection
- Connect to multiple Plex and Jellyfin servers simultaneously
- Smart server discovery with automatic connection management

Customization

- Dark and light themes to match your preference
- Customizable subtitle styling and positioning
- Configurable playback controls and gestures
- Adjustable grid density for browsing your library your way
